newsitem.title: USA: Nobel Education CFO Richard Altus resigns.
newsitem.headline: Nobel Education CFO Richard Altus resigns.

text.p: Nobel Education Dynamics Inc said Friday that Richard Altus, executive vice president, had left the company for personal reasons.
Chief Executive Jack Clegg said the company is searching for a replacement for Altus, who also served as chief financial officer.
"We're taking time to make sure the search is correct, because we made a mistake the first time," Clegg said.
Altus joined Nobel early this year and resigned "because he did not fit in the management team," Clegg said.
